tools.name: bootstrap
tools.description: Bootstrap models/dictionaries and build indexes.

tools.name: build_index
tools.description: Build or update indexes for a repo (optionally SQLite + incremental).

sqlite.description: Build SQLite indexes after JSON indexes.

stubEmbeddings.description: Skip model downloads and use stub embeddings.

tools.name: build_sqlite_index
tools.description: Build SQLite indexes from JSON artifacts.

tools.name: cache_gc
tools.description: Garbage-collect repo caches.

tools.name: clean_artifacts
tools.description: Remove only the selected repo cache artifacts from approved owned storage.

tools.name: compact_sqlite_index
tools.description: Compact SQLite indexes to prune unused rows.

tools.name: config_status
tools.description: Inspect configuration and cache status, with warnings.

tools.name: context_pack
tools.description: Generate a composite context pack for a seed in the current code index.

workspacePath.description: Workspace config path (.jsonc) for federated risk packs.

tools.name: download_dictionaries
tools.description: Download dictionary wordlists into the shared cache.

tools.name: download_extensions
tools.description: Download the user-approved SQLite ANN artifact into managed storage.

tools.name: download_models
tools.description: Download embedding models into the shared cache.

tools.name: index_status
tools.description: Return cache and index status for a repo path.

tools.name: report_artifacts
tools.description: Report current artifact sizes for the repo and cache root.

tools.name: risk_delta
tools.description: Compare risk flows for one seed across two code-index refs.

includePartialFlows.description: Compare partial frontier flows in addition to full flows.

tools.name: risk_explain
tools.description: Explain interprocedural risk flows for a chunk in the current code index.

max.description: Maximum number of flows to return.

includePartialFlows.description: Include partial frontier flows when full flows are capped or incomplete.

maxPartialFlows.description: Maximum number of partial flows to return.

tools.name: runtime_evidence
tools.description: Query explicitly pinned saved runtime families with exact capture/source/workload/code-lifetime selectors. Never executes, probes or attaches.

tools.name: runtime_families
tools.description: Discover retained immutable saved runtime families within an authorized repository destination. Bounded paging; never captures or executes.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Run a search query against the repo index.

output.description: Return compact JSON (default) or full payload.

allowSparseFallback.description: Allow ANN fallback when sparse-only is requested but sparse is unavailable.

allowUnsafeMix.description: Allow compatibility/profile cohort mixing when keys do not match.

modifiedAfter.description: Filter by last modified date (parseable string).

case.description: Case-sensitive matching for file/path and tokens.

tools.name: search_workspace
tools.description: Run federated search across repos from a workspace configuration.

search.description: Single-repo search knobs forwarded per repo (mode/top/backend/filter/etc).

tools.name: semantic_detail
tools.description: Inspect exact semantic records, ordered operands, interned names and chunk ownership in an explicit immutable generation. Supports bounded paging; analysis coverage may remain unsupported.

tools.name: semantic_trace
tools.description: Trace source-pinned value relationships with evidence, boundary requests and explicit incomplete frontiers. Does not execute runtime capture.

tools.name: triage_context_pack
tools.description: Generate a triage context pack for a finding.

stubEmbeddings.description: Use stub embeddings for evidence search.

tools.name: triage_decision
tools.description: Create a triage decision record linked to a finding.

tools.name: triage_ingest
tools.description: Ingest vulnerability findings into triage records.

strict.description: Fail when malformed JSONL records are encountered.

buildIndex.description: Build the records index after ingest.

tools.name: verify_extensions
tools.description: Verify the user-approved SQLite ANN artifact; non-loading by default.

load.description: Explicitly load the user-approved artifact (default false; requires server launch authorization).
